Entries.Original: Girls, let's have a pre-op celebratory gig today.
I don't know where to even begin picking apart what you just said.
Firstly, why is it a pre-op celebration?
Pre-op like, pre-operation. Y'know, since the operation is coming up soon.
That ain't really somethin' to be celebratin' over.
But think about it—we only have today to really let loose. Starting tomorrow, we'll have to focus on the upcoming mission, right?
We could start focusing on the mission today, right now.
But if we can't play now, when ARE we going to play?!
We've been playing a lot, haven't we?
But it's not enough, right?! We need to use up everything we've got to show off what we've honed in practice!
Why, exactly, do we need to "use up everything" right before a big operation? Shouldn't we be conserving energy instead?
How do I convince her?
Make a persuasive argument|Throw a tantrum
Look, Yukkie. It only takes two or three dry days before people start getting frustrated. So if you want that release, if you want to feel good...we gotta let it out NOW.
We're all girls. I'm not sure your uhh...innuendo really works here.
Darn. That means I only have one other option...
WAAAHH! I want to plaaay! After all the practice we went through, we HAVE to plaaay!!!
This is your last resort? Whining like a kid?
WAAAHH! I want to plaaay! After all the practice we went through, we HAVE to plaaay!!!
You're such a kid.
I think Aoi is waiting for us right now anyways, so we should at least head down to meet her.
You're probably right, but...
Okay, gang! Let's get rolling!
